ai.title: AWS cost analysis agent
ai.description: A tool-using agent written from first principles on the Bedrock Converse API, then rebuilt in the Strands Agents SDK. Four Python tools over live Cost Explorer data, an eval harness that took the pass rate from about 74% to 100%, and a least-privilege IAM role proven by allow and deny tests.
ai.stack: Python, boto3, Bedrock Converse API, Strands Agents SDK, Amazon Nova

ai.title: BrainBox
ai.description: A personal knowledge assistant on the Claude API, built in phases: multi-turn chat with memory, then a RAG knowledge base on AWS, tool use and production. Along the way, structured-output tools that return JSON, like a flashcard generator and a sentiment analyser.
ai.stack: Python, Anthropic Claude API, Sonnet and Haiku

ai.title: Meeting intelligence tool
ai.description: An event-driven pipeline that turns meeting recordings into transcripts, summaries, decisions and action items, with plain-language Q&A over past meetings using RAG.
ai.stack: Transcribe, Step Functions, Lambda, Bedrock, Titan Embeddings, OpenSearch Serverless

ai.title: QnABot with Amazon Bedrock
ai.description: Deployed QnABot on AWS as infrastructure as code and packaged it as a partner offering, with Bedrock embeddings and LLM answers. The v7.4.0 release shipped an empty website.zip, so I traced it and hot-patched it live with v7.3.16 assets.
ai.stack: QnABot on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, CloudFormation

cloud.title: Contact centre move to Amazon Connect
cloud.description: At NTT I led an on-premises contact centre migration to Amazon Connect as architect and project manager, and built the integrations around it: Lambda functions wired into Connect, DynamoDB and Lex IVR, plus custom notifications with SNS and SES. The work helped the team earn Amazon Connect Service Delivery Partner status.
cloud.stack: Amazon Connect, Lambda, DynamoDB, Lex, SNS, SES

cloud.title: Pipelines and infrastructure as code
